## Requested role

Independent reviewer of the factor definitions, boundaries, and 24 gold-free probe cases in `data/lab/pmlab-salience-ontology-review-v0/blind/`.

This review is about an external memory-control ontology. It does not claim that an LLM feels emotion. An author-operated API worker may advise but cannot satisfy the independent gate.

## Prior exposure and conflicts

- [ ] I have not inspected or run a candidate salience controller; none should exist.
- [ ] I did not receive preferred probe answers from the author.
- [ ] I will not treat salience as truth, validity, or authorization.
- [ ] I will disclose all tools, collaborators, conflicts, and prior exposure.

## Workflow

- [ ] Read `blind/review-manual.md` and verify the hashes in `blind/manifest.json`.
- [ ] Copy and complete `blind/review-form.json`; do not overwrite the blank form.
- [ ] Review all 12 factors and all 24 probes before author discussion.
- [ ] Complete the matching attestation and bind it to the manifest and review hashes.
- [ ] Validate with `python scripts/validate_salience_ontology_review_v0.py --review PATH --attestation PATH`.
- [ ] Freeze the signed files before requesting author disposition.

An `accept` decision permits corpus construction only. It does not unlock controller implementation, automatic ranking, deletion, or architecture promotion.
